summary: Flashes a force-field shader brightly on impact.
overview: Drop it alongside a Renderer using the force-field shader and call TriggerHitFlash on impact — typically from a Health damage event — for a brief bright pulse.
useCases: A shield bubble reacting to being shot.
A barrier the player can see is being hit.
Any surface that should flash where it is struck.

gotchas.title: The flash is global to the material, not at the hit point
gotchas.body: The whole field brightens rather than rippling from where it was hit. The ripple emitter is the tool for a positioned reaction.
